method: Same Chromium page per dataset, memory only, no storage/network/compilation in timed regions. Six paths: SQLike JS/Wasm GC AOT and dynamic; SQLite WASM cached prepared and prepare/finalize each call. Pre-encoded SQLike bindings and pre-decoded SQLite bindings; all results normalized to typed positional Cell arrays. SQLite type queries/BigInt and SQLike response JSON.parse included, not identical ABI. Native SQLite oracle and UPDATE side effects checked before/after timing. Rotated order, 7 samples, adaptive warmups by dataset and two calibration rounds targeting 50ms per engine/sample (actual iterations recorded). UPDATE repeatedly sets the same value after its first verified change. Main range timings are warm. firstRangeRead is one un-warmed API call, including first preparation/index build, not a median. Separate indexLifecycle probes run after main timings: each cycle changes an indexed n value between -7/-8 outside the requested positive range, then performs a range read; timings include both operations and rebuilds. Profiles collected separately after measurements, 1ms sampling, 1 second each; profile durations are not benchmark timings. No forced GC.
